objective.text: Use data_get wildcards to traverse nested structures with missing-value defaults.

difficulty.rationale: Apply a fallback to each missing leaf in a wildcard traversal.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

options.rationale: The missing leaf is represented by the supplied default rather than dropped.

options.rationale: An explicit default was provided, so the absent second name does not use the usual null fallback.

options.rationale: One missing leaf does not replace the entire wildcard result with the default.

options.rationale: The wildcard visits each row, and the missing name in the second row receives the supplied default.
